evidence: Implements BIP 54 consensus validation rules across block headers and transaction verification in src/validation.cpp and src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp.
rationale: Implements the BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules to resolve long-standing consensus vulnerabilities including timewarp difficulty manipulation, Merkle tree leaf-node collisions (CVE-2017-12842), and legacy sigops validation CPU exhaustion. Enabling the rules exclusively on regtest provides substantial, durable value for evaluating the consensus changes in the repository while intentionally deferring mainnet activation.
